title: Chananyah ben Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1, Rabbi Yitzchak bar Tavlai asks Rabbi Yochanan, who tells him, “Ask Chananyah ben Shmuel, the baraita reciter.” Hyman explains that he recited baraitot in Rabbi Yochanan’s academy. In Shabbat 1:1, folio 2b, and Sukkah 1:1, Rabbi Chaninah ben Shmuel recites, “All the vessels that were in the Temple,” etc.

notes.text: The shortened ב״ש is ben Shmuel here, not Beit Shammai. Shabbat 1:1 explicitly names Chananyah bar Shmuel; Sukkah 1:1 has Chaninah ben Shmuel. The 2b locator and the different Chananyah/Chaninah spellings are retained.
